user_question: Powered from laptop USB through a long thin cable; SG90 servo on the same 5V rail.

reference_context.title: ESP32 Series Datasheet (Espressif)
reference_context.snippet: Wi-Fi transmit current can reach about 240 mA peak (802.11b at maximum output power). The power supply must be able to deliver these current peaks without the supply voltage dropping.

expected.root_cause: Supply voltage sags when the Wi-Fi radio transmits (plus servo load on a weak USB/long cable), tripping the brownout detector.
expected.fix: Use a stronger supply/short cable, power the servo separately, add bulk capacitance near the ESP32; do not just disable the brownout detector.
